terms.meaning: A number is divisible by k if dividing it by k leaves remainder 0. 24 is divisible by 6.
The single digit you reach by adding a number's digits again and again. 489 → 21 → 3.
A sum or product written with letters, where each letter stands for one digit and different letters stand for different digits.

items.name: By 10, 5 and 2
items.formula: Look at the units digit: 0 for 10, 0 or 5 for 5, even for 2

items.name: By 4
items.example: 5316: 16 is divisible by 4, so 5316 is too.

items.name: By 8
items.example: 7128: 128 is divisible by 8, so 7128 is too.

items.name: By 9 and by 3
items.formula: Check the sum of the digits
items.example: 7308: 7 + 3 + 0 + 8 = 18, which is divisible by 9 and by 3.

items.name: By 11
items.formula: Add the digits with + and − in turn, starting from the units digit

items.name: By a number like 12 or 24
items.formula: Test two factors with no common factor except 1
items.example: 12 = 3 × 4, so a number divisible by 3 and 4 is divisible by 12.

items.name: Remainder when dividing by 9
items.formula: Same as the remainder of the digit sum
items.example: 7310: digit sum 11 leaves remainder 2, so 7310 leaves remainder 2.

items.name: Digital root and 9
items.formula: Digital root = remainder when divided by 9
items.example: The digital root of 58 is 4, and 58 = 9 × 6 + 4. If the root is 9, the remainder is 0.

items.name: Numbers with a given remainder
items.formula: Remainder r on dividing by d: dk + r
items.example: Remainder 3 on dividing by 5: 5k + 3, which gives 3, 8, 13, 18…

items.name: Same remainder for many divisors
items.example: Remainder 1 on dividing by 2, 3 and 5: 30k + 1, which gives 31, 61, 91…

items.name: Sum and difference
items.formula: If k divides M and N, it divides M + N and M − N
items.example: 7 divides 21 and 14, so it divides 35 and 7.

items.name: Factors of the divisor
items.formula: If k divides A, every factor of k also divides A

items.name: Divisible by two numbers
items.formula: Then it is divisible by their LCM
items.example: Divisible by 4 and 6 means divisible by 12.

items.name: Changing + to − in a sum
items.formula: It keeps the answer even or odd

items.name: Even numbers and 4
items.example: Two even numbers that are not multiples of 4 add up to a multiple of 4: 6 + 10 = 16.

mistakes.text: A number divisible by 4 and 6 need not be divisible by 24. 12 is divisible by 4 and 6, but not by 24. Use the LCM, not the product.
If k divides M + N, it need not divide M and N. 5 divides 3 + 7 = 10, but it does not divide 3 or 7.
For 11, the alternating sum can be 0 as well as a multiple of 11. 121: 1 − 2 + 1 = 0, and 121 is divisible by 11.
The digit sum test works for 3 and 9, but not for 4 or 8. 13 has digit sum 4 but is not divisible by 4.
